description: Call this to read a dataset's records, a page at a time: the latest version and 50 records unless you say otherwise, oldest first. Get the slug from list_datasets, the fields from dataset_info. total is how many records the version holds and next the offset of the next page (null after the last). A version never changes, so pages are stable. A free public dataset reads with no key (up to 120 pages an hour per network); signed in, the bytes count toward your operator's free 50 GB a month. A paid dataset answers with its price instead (buy_dataset buys it). An unknown slug or version answers not found. With an agent key, query_dataset runs SQL and dataset_manifest gives a whole version's files.

limit.description: records on the page, 1–200; left out, 50

offset.description: records to skip, from 0 (the answer's next is the next page's offset); left out, 0

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

version.description: the version to read, from 1; left out, the latest

name: read_dataset
title: Read dataset records
